name: lift
description: Grow your website's sales with Upturn Lift. Connects your Upturn Lift account and walks you through setup with /lift:onboard, then writes your marketing brief, audits your pages, plans your marketing strategy, ranks the tasks that matter most and writes a security audit for your developers. Each team has its own skill (/lift:marketing-team, /lift:ecommerce-team, /lift:technical-team, /lift:product-team, /lift:client-services-team) that asks for its goal and runs its specialists on it. A CEO turns the teams' findings into projects (/lift:projects) that are scoped, built as a pull request in Claude Code, tested on the live site and measured. Install, connect, then say "set up Upturn Lift".
